tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.25;
son of: Parnach (H6535)
§ Elizaphan or Elzaphan = "my God has protected"
1) a Kohathite chief in the wilderness
2) a Zebulunite chief
3) Uzziel's son, Mishael's brother in time of Moses

strongs_1890.derivation: or (shortened) אֶלְצָפָן; from H410 (אֵל) and H6845 (צָפַן); God of treasure;
